content.text:
`study.json` has been written. Here is a summary of every decision made:

---

### What was found in the MJCF

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Top-level file** | `scene.xml` → `<include file="piper.xml"/>` |
| **Body chain** | `base_link → link1 → link2 → link3 → link4 → link5 → link6 → {link7, link8}` |
| **Arm joints** | `joint1`–`joint6` — all **hinge**, axis `[0 0 1]` in local frame, ranges ±2.618 / 0→π / −2.697→0 / ±1.832 / ±1.22 / ±π |
| **Finger joints** | `joint7` (slide, axis `[0 0 −1]`, 0→0.035 m) on `link7`; `joint8` (slide, axis `[0 0 1]`, −0.035→0 m) on `link8` |
| **Equality constraint** | `joint8 = −1 × joint7` — the two jaws are mechanically coupled; only **one** actuator (`gripper`) drives `joint7` |
| **Actuators** | 7 `<position>` actuators: `joint1`–`joint6` + `gripper` (all inherit ctrlrange from joint range) |
| **ee_site** | `ee_site` — declared on `link6`, offset `pos="0 0 0.13"` (between finger tips) |
| **ee_body** | `link8` (deepest leaf; `link7` is the other finger) |
| **Graspable bodies** | None — no free-joint bodies in the scene |
| **Classification** | **`arm`** — single fixed-base serial kinematic chain, 6 revolute arm joints + 1 parallel-jaw gripper |
| **DOF** | **7** (6 arm + 1 gripper actuator) |
